review_notes: Same 2026-08-06 Barahkilo/Gorkha-11 petrol-pump landslide: both records describe the morning failure behind the fuel station that damaged pump equipment and buried five parked motorcycles.

review_notes: Exact match to the Pokhara-19 Purunchaur/Tallakot household landslide on 2024-07-12: both records report the same house failure and seven deaths from Kul Bahadur Pariyar's family.

evidence: A separate landslide at Chainpur Barhabise, Pokhara-32, buried a house at about 2:15 a.m. and killed three people.
review_notes: Same Pokhara-32 Chainpur/Barhabise household landslide on 2024-07-12. The existing report is the early two-dead/one-missing account of this same house failure, later confirmed at three deaths.
